customQuotes: ["Mercy is weakness; only the relentless survive.","Conquer every obstacle and burn the bridge behind you.","Build your empire out of pure, unyielding discipline.","Your career is warfare—crush every enemy line.","Rip victory from the hands of the hesitant.","The world belongs to cold, calculating dominance.","Destroy your weaknesses before your enemies exploit them.","Sharpen yourself like a weapon meant for ruin.","Second place is just a polite word for defeat.","Leave humanity behind and outwork every soul alive.","Create a siege and starve out the opposition.","Conquer everything they claimed was impossible.","You aren't here for balance; you're here for power.","Pain passes, but weakness rots your ambition forever.","Treat every day like a battle for total survival.","Ruthless execution is the minimum requirement for greatness.","Outwork everyone until your name strikes fear.","No excuses, no compromise, and no retreat.","If you want authority, prepare for endless warfare.","Strike hard, strike fast, and never halt the march.","Suffocate the competition before they even begin.","Forge yourself into a force that crushes mountains.","Sympathy is a luxury you cannot afford.","Build your fortress directly on their ruins.","Make your drive so terrifying that doubt suffocates.","Victory is taken by the most unforgiving force.","Turn ambition into a calculated, lethal assault.","Strike with efficiency; leave no survivors on the battlefield.","Crush your limits or step aside for someone who will.","History only remembers the ruthless who took control."]
